title: LocalIntent: Outcome-Specific Structured Generation for Backend-Compatible Smart Building Automation with Local LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.23511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Locally deployed large language models (LLMs) can reduce reliance on remote cloud services for natural language smart building automation, but backend-facing processing requires correct outcome selection, alignment with local capabilities, and valid structured outputs. We investigate whether a complete outcome-specific prompting design improves compact-model outputs beyond generic route-then-generate prompting. The proposed LocalIntent approach routes requests to ordinary or persistent-rule branches: the former produces commands, clarifications, or rejections, while the latter generates trigger-action rules, followed by deterministic validation. We evaluate four locally executed Gemma and Qwen models spanning 2B-9B parameters on 101 non-persistent and 54 persistent-rule records, comparing Monolithic prompting, generic two-stage prompting, LocalIntent, and validation-guided repair. translated_title: LocalIntent：面向本地大语言模型的智慧楼宇自动化后端兼容的特定结果结构化生成
translated_abstract: 本地部署的大语言模型（LLM）可以降低智慧楼宇自然语言自动化对远程云服务的依赖，但面向后端的处理需要正确的结果选择、与本地能力的对齐，以及有效的结构化输出。我们研究一种完整的面向特定结果的提示设计，是否能够超越通用的“先路由后生成”式提示，从而改进紧凑型模型的输出。所提出的 LocalIntent 方法将请求路由到普通分支或持久规则分支：前者生成命令、澄清请求或拒绝响应，后者生成触发-动作规则，随后进行确定性验证。我们在 101 条非持久记录和 54 条持久规则记录上评估了四个本地运行的 Gemma 和 Qwen 模型（参数量介于 2B 至 9B 之间），比较了单体式提示、通用两阶段提示、LocalIntent 以及验证引导的修复方法。在所评估的数据集上，LocalIntent 取得了最高的……
tldr: LocalIntent 提出了一种面向特定结果的提示与结构化生成方法，将请求路由至普通命令分支或触发-动作规则分支并辅以确定性验证，使 2B–9B 参数量的本地小模型在智慧楼宇自动化任务中超越通用提示方案，实现后端兼容的可靠结构化输出。
en_tdlr: LocalIntent introduces an outcome-specific prompting and structured generation design that routes requests to ordinary command branches or trigger-action rule branches with deterministic validation, enabling compact 2B–9B local LLMs to outperform generic prompt baselines for backend-compatible smart building automation.
